bio.text: Marni von Wilpert, a Democrat, has represented District 5 on the San Diego City Council since 2020 and is a candidate for California's 48th Congressional District in 2026.

According to her campaign website, she grew up in North San Diego County, served in the Peace Corps in Botswana, was counsel on the House Education and Labor Committee, and was a civil prosecutor in the San Diego City Attorney's Office.
The site says she chairs the council's Public Safety Committee.
